description: This file defines a PHP interface 'WebDocument' which provides an external API for document storage operations such as upload, download, share, delete, and search.

classes.name: WebDocument
classes.description: A PHP interface outlining methods for document management, intended for external API interaction.

methods.name: uploadDoc
methods.description: Uploads a document given a bean, file, document name, and MIME type.

methods.name: downloadDoc
methods.description: Downloads a document identified by document ID and format.

methods.name: shareDoc
methods.description: Shares a document with specified email addresses.

methods.name: deleteDoc
methods.description: Deletes a document identified by document ID.

methods.name: searchDoc
methods.description: Searches documents based on keywords, with optional cache flush.
